actual_request.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete original production sprite of 10_crimson_spear_girl, a grounded short-step walking pose, native square at least 1024x1024, genuinely transparent RGBA. No sheet, text, ground, shadow, checkerboard or background. Image 1 is authoritative identity: exact brown double buns AND two long twin tails with red ribbons, gold/turquoise ornaments, amber eyes, jeweled forehead charm, original red/ivory/gold embroidered layered dress, white sleeves and skirt frills, gold waist beads, red/gold boots. Image 2 is the confirmed main STYLE reference, clean bright rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted detail, restrained warm shading, delicate polished edges; do not copy its UI or other people. Image 3 fixes production body/head size, short chibi proportions, outfit, spear and stable two-hand grip. Preserve identity and these proportions; natural three-dimensional turning, never a mirror. Same long dark-shaft crimson crystal and gold spear with red tassels; anatomical LEFT hand high at chest, RIGHT hand low at waist, both physically on ONE straight shaft. Entire spear including butt, head, twin tails, ribbons, sleeves and both boots inside canvas, with margin. Fixed slightly elevated game camera. At 1024 scale: body center x512, virtual ground root [512,942], body/buns-to-boots about700px; full weapon bounds x65..960,y45..952. Maintain compact, balanced small stride, no running/jump/attack/high knee/crossed legs. Anatomical left/right always means HER left/right. Every frame has at least one grounded supporting foot. Torso almost vertical; subtle hair/sleeve inertia only. Highest available finish, no colored matte or purple fringe. DIRECTION WEST: pure LEFT-FACING side profile, nose and toes point screen-left, no frontal three-quarter face. HER anatomical LEFT leg and arm are NEAR viewer, RIGHT leg and arm are FAR. Near LEFT upper arm comes from near shoulder and its LEFT hand is the HIGH grip at chest. FAR RIGHT hand is the LOW grip at waist; do NOT swap the hands. FRAME W09 of a16-frame walk at30ms: Initial RIGHT heel/sole contact ahead; RIGHT leg leads, LEFT leg behind with toe still touching ground and heel raised. Short double support. Far RIGHT boot must be distinctly further screen-left than near LEFT boot for W, opposite leading leg from01. New WEST pose, deliberately opposite stride to a left-leading step. The NEAR LEFT thigh goes BACKWARDS to screen-right from hip; NEAR left knee and boot are on SCREEN RIGHT, with toe on ground and heel lifted. The FAR RIGHT thigh goes FORWARDS to screen-left from hip; far RIGHT knee and boot are on SCREEN LEFT, heel touches ground. The leading screen-left boot is FAR and appears behind the near shin in depth; the trailing screen-right shin is NEAR and overlaps in front. Keep both femurs connected to correct hips, no crossed legs. Explicit near-left hand HIGH, far-right hand LOW; spear blade upper-right, butt lower-left. Do not draw the near-left leg leading.
